description: Least-privilege capability for the main window: core app/window basics, the explicit native security commands, SQL access to the single local application database, and HTTP access scoped to the Tenders-SA application API path only. No shell, filesystem, or URL-opening access is granted; those are added only by the task that needs them, scoped to what it needs. The http allow-list is a security boundary, not configuration: it bounds the set of origins the runtime API base URL may point at, and src/tests/capability-scope.test.ts fails if it is widened. It holds exactly two entries -- the production application API and the localhost development server -- because the runtime base URL is unusable unless its origin appears here, so a production build with only the localhost entry would have every request denied by the plugin.
